name: io.github.Servosity/servosity-mcp
title: Servosity MCP
description: Fleet-wide backup triage, stale-backup detection, and cross-engine analytics for any MCP agent.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile, so every call answers for that customer. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.

environmentVariables.name: SERVOSITY_MSP_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the Servosity API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: SERVOSITY_MSP_RESELLER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Numeric reseller ID from the partner portal, used to scope reseller reports. Leave blank to let the CLI probe for it from your account.

environmentVariables.name: SERVOSITY_MSP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Servosity partner API token from the partner portal. Scoped to your reseller account only.

environmentVariables.name: SERVOSITY_MSP_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Servosity requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.
